### Page 2

iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max推出
• 蘋果新一代高階旗艦智慧型手機 ，在智慧功能、處理效能、電池續航與攝影系統四方面迎來
重大突破。外觀及材質採用同色調配色的鋁金屬邊框結合一體成型背面玻璃 ，提供4種配色，
包括太空黑、銀色、冰川藍以及勃根地紅。
• 螢幕互動介面：動態島縮小，支援同時顯示多達 3 個即時動態。
• Siri AI整合：由最新的Apple Foundation Models與端側模型驅動，具備擬真人聲、自訂語
速抑揚頓挫、螢幕感知、跨App執行指令與全系統精確聽寫。
• iPhone接力通話：允許兩部 iPhone共享同一個電話號碼 ，拿起任一部手機即能無縫通話
（首波與T-Mobile、德國電信合作，後續納入Verizon與EE）。
• AirDrop速度提升達 80%，行動網路與 Wi-Fi 自動無縫切換。

AAPL
資料來源： AAPL、中信投顧整理

### Page 3

18 pro系列核心處理器升級：A20 Pro 晶片
• 先進製程：採用最新2nm製程技術打造，具備更高的電晶體密度。
• 6核心CPU：配置2顆桌面級全新超級核心，效能提升達20%，為智慧型手機中最快核心；搭配4顆
高能效核心，並全數整合神經加速器以驅動低延遲裝置端AI。
• 7核心GPU：圖形運算效能較前代大幅躍升 40%，微架構針對3A級手遊優化；配備全新神經加速
器，其8位元浮點運算吞吐量提升達2倍，可於本機直接運行第三方大型語言模型。
• 雙神經網路引擎：額外配置第二組神經網路引擎，核心總數達32核心，本機AI運算能力倍增。
• 記憶體介面：記憶體頻寬大幅提升50%，為 iPhone 歷來最寬的記憶體匯流排介面。
• WMCM封裝：借鑒Apple M系列晶片架構，採用全新特製封裝，將晶圓裸晶與記憶體並排佈局，
移出SoC主要熱路徑，使晶粒直接與均熱板貼合，提升散熱效能。
2
AAPL
資料來源： AAPL、中信投顧整理

### Page 4

散熱系統與續航快充
• 新一代散熱Vapor Chamber：表面積為iPhone 17 Pro的3倍，內部去離子水持續循環導熱；
均熱板採用80%回收不銹鋼製成，並搭配高導熱石墨片。
• 奈米雙晶銅材料：業界首創散熱材料 ，能增強機身結構剛性，並快速將熱量自顯示螢幕引導
排除。
• 持續效能釋放：高負載下持續效能較iPhone 17 Pro提升 40%，為iPhone 16 Pro及更早機
型的2倍。
• 電池續航力：(1)iPhone 18 Pro：機身小巧，但擁有與iPhone 17 Pro Max相同的全天候續
航；純 eSIM 機型之影片播放時間達 36 小時；真實綜合日常使用模型下可達 24小時。(2)
iPhone 18 Pro Max純eSIM機型影片播放時間高達 45 小時；綜合使用模型下每次充電可達
30 小時。有線快速充電：充電約 15 分鐘可充至 50% 電量；充電 5 分鐘可提供約 6 小時影
片播放時間。

AAPL

### Page 5

專業相機系統
• 4,800萬像素Fusion主相機：搭載可變光圈 ，採用6片雷射切割葉片 ，葉片厚度薄於人類頭髮 ，由特製聚
合物複合材料製成；搭配微型轉子機構與客製光學鏡片組。
• 可調節光圈：暗光環境自動切換至 F1.8 大光圈，進光量增加約 50%，提升夜間人像與星空攝影品質；光
線充足時縮小光圈以加深景深，確保群體合照邊角與前後背景清晰。
• Pro Controls：提供相機手動操作介面，支援手動微調4檔光圈、白平衡、直方圖曝光監控、手動快門速
度調整。
• 錄影與對焦升級：支援拍攝後添加電影級景深且開放60 FPS半速慢動作；支援4K Dolby Vision HDR縮時
攝影；Audio Mix升級聲音與音樂演算法；智慧對焦追蹤利用AI本機模型牢牢鎖定進出畫面的動態主體。
• 攝影風格升級：新增照片紋理與膠卷顆粒感調節，可即時調整膚質質感並支援無損復原。
• 影像真實性：除相容SynthID標記AI生成圖外，推出Apple Reference Image憑證機制。感光元件在拍攝

瞬間即在像素層級對照片進行安全密碼學簽署 ，私有雲端運算會沖印成一份不可修改的數位負片 ，與一
般可編輯相片共同儲存於照片App中，以證明照片原始未經變造。

### Page 6

蘋果首款摺疊旗艦：iPhone Duo
• 蘋果推出首款旗艦摺疊機iPhone Duo，將iPad級別的大螢幕整合至小巧機身中，採書本式對折，非對稱
式對角圓角線條，展開時為iPhone歷來最薄機身，核心組件高度整合在相機凸起處內部 ，留出內部空間
配置雙電池模組。螢幕正面為Ceramic Shield 2、背面為Ceramic Shield，並具備完整IP68等級防塵防水。
• 機身：邊框由5級鈦金屬精工切削並呈現拋光鏡面質感；天線斷點處導入 陶瓷纖維增強嵌件強度為5級鈦
金屬的3倍。
• 內外螢幕：展開為7.6 吋Super Retina XDR螢幕，具窄邊框與一致的長寬比，外螢幕：5.4 吋顯示螢幕，
具備相當於iPhone 18 Pro 90%的可用顯示面積。內螢幕影片可播放31小時，外螢幕播放達44小時，雙
螢幕平均綜合使用續航達24小時。
• 後置鏡頭：4,800萬像素 Fusion 主鏡頭(支援2x光學品質望遠、4K 120 FPS慢動作錄影與4K杜比視界縮
時)+4,800 萬像素 Fusion超廣角鏡頭。

• Apple Pencil支援：雙螢幕皆支援Apple Pencil(USB-C)，為iPhone首度支援Apple Pencil手寫與繪圖。
• 側邊Touch ID：於側邊電源鍵整合TouchID指紋辨識(可註冊多組指紋)，亦支援Apple Watch自動解鎖。

iPhone Duo雙晶片架構，A20 Pro及自研C2晶片
6
AAPL

• A20 Pro晶片：採用2奈米與裸晶直貼散熱封裝 ，配合大型均熱板，持續效能較 iPhone 17
Pro提升35%；內建全新顯示引擎 ，可同時驅動雙螢幕並消除螢幕下鏡頭邊緣像素過渡走樣 。

由客製晶片與演算法自動調配充放平衡。

### Page 8

iPhone Duo無摺痕螢幕技術
• 鉸鏈：由超過100枚精密微型零組件與碳纖維承載支撐板組成 ，可變扭力曲線讓開闔阻尼手
感順暢，並整合磁鐵陣列牢固吸合。
• 螢幕防護多層貼合結構：表面採用奈米紋理抗眩光表面 ，利用無光罩雷射微影技術逐像素雕
刻微透鏡，呈現視覺平整霧面感，使中央摺痕在視覺上近乎隱形 。表層覆蓋高抗刮客製聚合
物，剛性提升40%。OLED面板上下皆夾有高強度超薄玻璃 ，並灌注黏彈性膠材 ，摺疊時各
層能如書頁滑移，避免反覆摺疊疲勞形變；底層襯有鈦金屬板強化支撐。
• 雷射製造公差控制：組裝以AI演算法將鉸鏈與外殼進行公差吻合配對；出廠前以共軛焦雷射
逐台掃描表面拓撲，並3D列印沉積多達25層光固化聚合物微層，消除微波紋。

### Page 10

新一代無線藍芽耳機AirPods 5
• 全新第5代半開放式真無線耳機，正式在全線AirPods系列中全面普及主動式降噪，降噪效能
比前代提升 50%。延續半開放式配戴設計，重新設計內部構造，貼合各類耳形幾何結構。
• 多孔聲學架構：全新多孔內部聲學管道 ，搭配新一代適應性等化功能 ，大幅提升低頻飽滿度
與高頻細節。
• 個人化空間音訊：提供包圍感更強的動態頭部追蹤空間音訊體驗。
• 通透模式與適應性音訊通透模式更加自然；適應性音訊能根據周圍環境噪音強度 ，在主動降
噪與通透模式之間即時自動混合調配。
• Apple Intelligence與Siri AI整合：可免持利用語音調用Siri AI，結合個人脈絡資料解答疑問；
支援即時翻譯功能。

### Page 11

Apple Watch Series 12/Apple Watch Ultra 4
• Apple Watch Series 12搭載新一代 S11 晶片，首度採二代Ceramic Shield 2，螢幕耐刮耐摔強度比前代
Ion-X玻璃高 60%。
• 電極接觸面積擴增：在相同錶背面積下增加電極表面積，提升ECG心電圖偵測的皮膚導電與接觸精準度。
• 環狀光電二極體陣列：重新設計的光電二極體以環狀結構排列，大幅提升對反射光線的捕捉效率。
• 全新健康App功能：(1)由 Apple Intelligence 自動生成個人生理趨勢摘要(如睡眠走勢或 VO2 Max 峰值)，
並動態給出間歇跑等運動調整建議 。(2)將體能指標與血檢生物標記對比實際年齡 ，分析日常習慣之健康
影響。(3)全方位量化睡眠、活動與心臟表現，支援手動同步病歷，或以 119 美元向Quest訂購50項生物
標記的血檢套裝，並在本機結合專家影片給出醫學解讀。(4)搭配iPhone相機與Apple Watch感測器，即

時語音校正關節動作，輔助 VO2 Max 測試或運動傷害復健進度追蹤。
• Apple Watch Ultra 4：為極限運動、專業冒險家與耐力賽事選手設計之頂級智慧手錶，日常一般使用續
航時間達2天以上。全功能開啟狀態(完整心率追蹤+全頻雙頻GPS)下，體能訓練時間達18小時。

### Page 12

相關台股供應鏈
• 全新(2455)、穩懋(3105)：因Wi-Fi 7相較於Wi-Fi 6在手機中新增6GHz的頻段，同時由於對PA性能要求，
將轉向使用GaAs作為材料。我們認為相關供應鏈如全新(2455)、穩懋(3105)，將受惠於手機廠導入Wi-Fi 7
，下半年PA相關台股供應鏈營運展望正向，若後續iPhone新機銷售表現佳，有望進一步對獲利有所挹注。
• 大立光(3008)：大立光受惠iPhone 18新機拉貨動能，且今年新旗艦機首度搭載可變光圈鏡頭，並且為主要
供應商，為2H26營運增加動能。大立光切入CPO應用，有利於推升評價，雖短期營收能見度有限，但預估
將於2028年實現量產並貢獻營收，有望成為自手機鏡頭外公司第二成長動能。過往大立光在手機鏡頭本業
的營運上升週期下 ，預估本益比約交易在 15至18倍左右，而公司成功切入CPO元件市場，市場現給予25-
30倍以上本益比左右。
• 奇鋐(3017)：過去iPhone 17 Pro 首度導入超薄 VC，隨AI 負載提升，我們預期 VC 將逐步成為蘋果高階手

機、平板及折疊旗艦標配。折疊機預計採用雙片式超薄VC，帶動單機用量與ASP倍增；我們預期奇鋐可取
得約50%市占率，有望明顯受惠於蘋果高階手持裝置散熱需求成長。
• 新日興(3376)：在折疊機軸承(Hinge)方面，Apple為實現極致的無感摺痕與耐用度 ，軸承內部結構更為複
雜，零件數及加工精度均較現有非蘋產品大幅提升，帶動單機軸承模組 ASP 接近倍增。台系供應鏈中，我
們認為新日興(3376)受惠程度最高。新日興與主要組裝代工廠鴻海(2317) 透過合資關係合作，有助於整合
機構件製造與組裝，並提升初期量產良率；我們預期其有望取得 Apple 首款折疊機的高階軸承訂單，成為
新日興中長期獲利的重要成長動能。
• 鴻海(2317): 鴻海負責蘋果首款摺疊機的整機組裝與最終調整，並與軸承廠新日興深化合作，共同搶攻高精
密轉軸商機。高毛利的新機效應將顯著拉抬整體產品組合與獲利表現。結合 AI 伺服器業務的持續高成長，
未來營運展望樂觀。

### Page 1

UMT provides rectangular waveguides, which are conducting pipes with a 
rectangular cross-section used to guide the propagation of microwave or mmwave 
signals. Different shapes and combinations of waveguides can form various RF 
passive components, such as filter / diplexer, coupler, isolator, antenna, power 
amplifiers (PAs), etc. The company serves leading global LEO satellite operators, and 
its waveguides can be seen in LEO satellites / payloads (main), and gateways in 
ground stations.

### Page 2

LEO satellite launches update: Starlink launched 261 LEO satellites in Aug 2026, or 
+13% MoM. The number of satellites per launch continues to increase from 24 satellites 
per launch in May 2026 to 26 satellites per launch in Aug 2026, and at 27 satellites per 
launch so far in Sep 2026, reaffirming our positive view on the constellation construction 
cycle. On Sep 18, SpaceX’s Starship V3 is scheduled to have the 3rd flight and the first 
Starship flight to deploy satellites (a group of Starlink satellites) into stable LEO, and 
should have the 4th flight of Starship V3 within 2026 (link). Starship V3 is a reusable 
vehicle, with LEO capacity at 100k kg, or 339% higher than Falcon 9 Block 5 (22.8kg), the 
current vehicle that Starlink is using. The vehicle migration would not only accelerate 
Starlink’s satellite launches but also release the legacy vehicle (e.g. Falcon 9 Block 5) to 
other LEO satellite operators, facilitating the overall industry’s satellite launches. For 
example, Amazon has planned 10 launches (LF-04 to LF-13) in 2029, using Falcon 9 
Block 5. Assuming 27 satellites per launch via the vehicle, the 10 missions would bring 
270 satellites (vs. 180 / 216 satellites in 2025 / 7M26 that Amazon added). Amazon is 
also increasing its satellites per launch: the upcoming pipeline shows 35-48 satellites per 
launch vs. 29-36 satellites per launch in May to July 2026, or increasing by 28% on avg. 
The acceleration of LEO satellite launches reaffirms our positive view on UMT.

Earnings revision: We factor in Aug revenues, and raise net income by 1% in 2026-28E. 
The revenue raise is to reflect our positive view on accelerating LEO satellite launches 
along with specification upgrade driving up the dollar content. Our GM is reduced to 
reflect our expectation that the larger scale would lead to lower GM with customers’ 
rising procurement power. Nevertheless, with the company’s product mix upgrade 
toward LEO satellite, the blended GM should continue to increase through 2028E.

Valuation: We continue to derive our target price based on a discounted P/E, and based 
on 2029E (methodology unchanged). We continue to derive the target P/E multiple from 
the average PEG&M ratio of peers in the satellite supply chain, and we remove outliers 
(those below 0.3x, which are mostly telecom operators who face competition from LEO 
satellite operators or having consumer electronics exposure which suffered from high 
memory costs). Our target 2029E discounted P/E multiple is at 37.0x (unchanged) which 
is based on peers’ avg. PEG&M, and UMT’s 2029-30E avg. NI YoY and OPM. We apply the 
37.0x multiple to 2029E EPS and discount it back to 2027E via a COE of 7.8% (no 
change). Our target price is at NT$2,557 (vs. NT$2,513 previously), implying 61x 2027E 
P/E, which is above the company’s average +1 stv. P/E of 42x, reflecting our positive view 
on UMT’s product mix upgrade toward LEO satellites. Maintain Buy.

Price target risks and methodology - UMT 
Valuation: We use a discounted P/E methodology and apply a 37.0x target P/E multiple 
to UMT’s 2029E EPS, discounting it back to 2027E at a COE of 7.8% (beta 1.2x, risk-free 
rate 1.6% and market risk premium at 5.1%), which leads to our 12-month target price 
of NT$2,557. The target P/E is based on the average PEG&M ratio of peers in the 
satellite supply chain. We are Buy-rated on UMT.  
Key Risks: Slower-than-expected LEO satellite deployment; Potential competition from 
new-entrant suppliers; LEO satellite operators manufacturing in-house components.

and represent investment recommendations focused on the size of the total return potential and/or the likelihood of the realization of the return across
their respective areas of coverage.  The addition or removal of stocks from such Conviction Lists are managed by the Investment Review Committee or
other designated committee in each respective region and do not represent a change in the analysts’ investment rating for such stocks.

Total return potential represents the upside or downside differential between the current share price and the price target, including all paid or
anticipated dividends, expected during the time horizon associated with the price target. Price targets are required for all covered stocks. The total
return potential, price target and associated time horizon are stated in each report adding or reiterating an Investment List membership.

Industry View In-Line
We keep our 3Q26 iPhone build estimate unchanged at 54M units (+4% q/q, -2%
y/y). The slower y/y run rate reflects new model SKUs shifting to the premium
segment (18 Pro/Pro Max and iPhone Fold), while the iPhone 18 model is scheduled

for introduction in 1H27. We introduce our 4Q26 iPhone build estimate at 73M
units (+35% q/q, -4% y/y). Total new iPhone 18 model family units reached 71M
units (-21% y/y) in 2H26, with one less SKU launched compared to last year. We
expect 7M units of iPhone Duo builds in 2H26. A starting price of US$1,999 (relative
to expectations of US$2,300 or higher) appears favorable to builds, but there are
likely still some production issues that the supply chain is working on. This is why

the iPhone Duo is available to  the market only one month later, and we will
continue to monitor ramp-up progress for any upside or downside to builds. Our full
year iPhone build estimate is 235M units (+3% y/y).
Our 3Q26 iPad build forecast is unchanged at 12M units (-8% q/q, -14% y/y). We
attribute the 3Q sequential decline to some pull-forward demand in 1H and the
impact of rising prices. We introduce our 4Q iPad build forecast at 11M units (-8%

q/q, -21% y/y). Our full year iPad build estimate is 46.1M units (-15% y/y).

## Document 108: 260915_ms_MLCC

Investment Perspective
MLCC is early cycle in AI server & rack penetration
There is immense change underway for the MLCC industry with an investment narrative
that is changing as AI chips/server demand is increasingly driving MLCC scarcity.  AI is
shifting from semiconductors to MLCCs, creating a supply/demand mismatch in high-end
components. The high-end AI MLCC market is effectively a Japanese-Korean duopoly with
Murata and SEMCO together hold around 85% share. High-capacitance, low-ESL parts for

AI accelerators require hundreds to over a thousand dielectric layers with near-zero
defects and face strict customer qualification — the barrier preventing a repeat of 2017-
18, when shortages invited entry and the cycle self-corrected. AI platforms now compete
directly with consumer, automotive, and industrial applications for advanced materials,
heightening supply risk for MLCC traditional customers. We are still in the early innings,
and supply concerns are extending beyond near-term shortages to longer-term supply

security. As a result, we are seeing an increasing number of long-term supply agreements
being signed between suppliers and customers.
Exhibit 1: Sequencing the technology cycle – still early cycle for MLCC
Source:  Morgan Stanley Research estimates
Turning point in MLCC pricing
While Murata Mfg.’s CFO and Executive Deputy President Masanori Minamide stated in a
Sep 14 Nikkei interview that rising production loads for high-end products are making it

increasingly difficult to fully supply low-end products, and that the priority of defending
low-end market share has effectively declined, we believe the company’s fundamental
policy of not changing prices based solely on short-term supply-demand conditions
remains intact. That said, in our view, Murata has been gradually shifting its strategy
toward focusing more on its areas of strength and adopting pricing that better reflects the
need to cover large-scale capital investments, particularly in those core segments where it

enjoys a competitive advantage. We believe that Murata’s reluctance to enter into L TAs for
AI/data-center use value added MLCCs reflects its view that locking in prices today may
not be optimal, given the potential for MLCC pricing to rise in the future.
We expect sales growth to continue for small-sized, high-
capacity, high-value-added MLCCs for AI servers/DCs

### Page 3

M
Japan Insight
Morgan Stanley MUFG 3
MLCCs are a key business, accounting for 50% of sales at Murata, 46% at SEMCO, 19% at
Yageo, and 70% at Taiyo Yuden in 2025. We expect global MLCC shipment value to
expand at a CAGR of 20.3%, from $18.51bn in 2025 to $44.45bn in 2031. We believe
growth is set to accelerate from the 5.0% CAGR recorded in global MLCC shipment value
over the 13 years of 2012-25 because we expect continued growth in sales of small, high-

capacity, high-value-added MLCCs for AI servers/datacenters (DCs) from 2026. For AI
servers/DCs alone, we forecast MLCC shipment value to reach $23.33bn by 2031 (vs. our
previous estimate of $10.80bn), implying a 57.1% CAGR (vs. 38.1%).
Howard Kao (our Greater China Technology Hardware analyst) expects MLCC demand
volume for VR200 NVL72 racks to increase about 80% versus GB300 NVL72 racks, and
forecasts the number of MLCCs mounted in each Rubin NVL72 rack will jump to roughly

570,000 units from around 320,000 for GB300 NVL72 racks, with MLCC dollar content
per rack estimated to increase by 166%.　We expect the rapid expansion of the high-value-
added MLCC market for AI servers/DCs to be especially positive for  earnings at Murata (#1
market share in MLCCs for 2025 at 41%) and SEMCO (#2 at 23%).

Key roles of MLCCs in AI/DC
MLCCs play a role in locally stabilizing power supply (instantaneous current supply plus

noise removal) near semiconductors, such as GPUs, CPUs, and FPGAs. Since GPUs, CPUs,
and FPGAs repeatedly switch on and off on a nanosecond timescale, they demand large
currents instantaneously, and MLCCs meet this instantaneous current demand by
immediately discharging their stored charge. As semiconductor miniaturization advances,
circuit operating speed increases and drive voltage falls. As voltage decreases, even small
voltage fluctuations risk causing semiconductor malfunction, so even more stable power

supply voltage is required than before. Demand for capacitor capacitance is also increasing
in line with AI servers' rising computing power and power consumption, and because
board area and mountable space are limited, we expect demand for smaller, higher-
capacity MLCCs to persist.
Sharp dips vs. share price peaks provide re-entry opportunity
Year-to-date to Sep 11, share prices of the four companies had risen 127% for Murata,
449% for SEMCO, 141% for Yageo, and 160% for Taiyo Yuden. However, from their

respective June-July peaks, these have fallen 40% for Murata, 38% for SEMCO, 52% for

### Page 4

M
Japan Insight
4
Yageo, and 59% for Taiyo Yuden. Considering the strong likelihood that high-value-added
products for AI servers/DCs will continue to drive growth in MLCC demand not only in
2026 but also from 2027 onward, and that each company's earnings will stay on an
expansionary trend, we believe the conditions are now in place to consider re-entering
these stocks.

Earnings and share price risks
We expect capital expenditure on AI/DC to keep expanding and generational transitions to

### Page 6

M
Japan Insight
6
continue in GPUs, sustaining growth in demand for small, high-capacity, high-value-added
MLCCs. Risks to the continuity of AI/DC capex expansion include: (1) rising risk from the
growing practice of hyperscalers and major semiconductor companies charging usage fees
in exchange for equity investments in AI development companies, conditional on the use
of their own cloud services or semiconductors; and (2) risk that AI/DC capex growth slows

due to bottlenecks, such as power infrastructure constraints. If the pace of AI/DC capex
growth slows, we cannot rule out that MLCC demand falls short of our base case outlook
for demand. Also, as shown in Exhibits Exhibit 8 Exhibit 8  and Exhibit 9 , during the IT
bubble around 2000, there was a strong correlation between the YoY change in Murata's
and Taiyo Yuden's monthly order intake and their market cap. Since order intake has risen

Role of MLCCs in AI servers
Capacitors, including multi-layer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), function as a “dam” that
temporarily stores electricity, and are an essential electronic component for noise removal

and voltage stabilization in virtually all electronic circuits, including those used in
computers, smartphones, and automobiles. MLCCs play a role in locally stabilizing power
supply (instantaneous current supply plus noise removal) near semiconductors such as
GPUs, CPUs, and FPGAs. Since GPUs, CPUs, and FPGAs repeatedly switch on and off on a
nanosecond timescale, they demand large currents instantaneously, and MLCCs meet this
instantaneous current demand by immediately discharging their stored charge. At the

same time, MLCCs bypass only the AC component (noise and fluctuating current), which
also serves to prevent noise from entering GPUs, CPUs, and FPGAs. MLCCs feature low
ESR (low resistance) and low ESL (low inductance), allowing them to track even

### Page 10

M
Japan Insight
10
nanosecond-level current fluctuations in semiconductors such as GPUs, CPUs, and FPGAs. 
MLCCs are often placed around components such as GPUs and ASICs that operate at low 
voltages of around 1.0V. As semiconductor miniaturization advances, circuit operating 
speed increases and drive voltage falls. As voltage decreases, even small voltage 
fluctuations risk causing semiconductor malfunction, requiring an even more stable power 
supply voltage than before. Demand for capacitor capacitance will also rise along with AI 
servers' improving computing power and increasing power consumption, and because 
board area and mountable space are limited, demand for smaller, higher-capacity MLCCs 
will likely continue. 
MLCC miniaturization and higher capacity to accelerate with 
VR200 NVL72
We assume that the space available for mounting MLCCs on VR200 NVL72 will not 
change significantly from the GB300 NVL72 rack, and that the transition from GB300 to 
VR200 will require installing higher-capacity MLCCs within the limited space of 
semiconductor ABF package substrates and AI accelerator boards, accelerating growth in 
demand for small-sized, high-capacity MLCCs. Murata has consistently been a leader in 
MLCC miniaturization and capacity increases, beginning mass production of 1005-size 1 F 
MLCCs in 2000 and 0402-size 1 F and 1005-size 22 F MLCCs in 2020. We expect 
demand for 1608-size 100 F, 1005-size 47 F, and 0603-size 10 F MLCCs to increase 
substantially with VR200 NVL72. We estimate that 1608-size 100 F MLCCs command a 
unit price 5-10x higher than 2012-size 100 F or 1608-size 47 F MLCCs, and we expect 
the shift to smaller, higher-capacity MLCCs accompanying the transition to VR200 NVL72 
to drive a substantial rise in ASP.

From a volume perspective, we estimate Cloud AI demand for 47µF+ MLCCs could

Materials development and production technology behind
MLCC miniaturization and capacity increases
In MLCCs, smaller sizes and higher capacities have mainly been achieved by thinning the
dielectric and electrode layers (layer thinning) and increasing the number of layers
stacked (multilayering). For high-capacity products for AI/DC, in addition to the layer
thinning and multilayering described above, efforts are accelerating to further miniaturize

and increase capacity by expanding the area of the dielectric and internal electrodes per
dielectric sheet. We believe MLCC miniaturization and capacity increases depend on: (1)
developing superior dielectric and electrode materials; (2) manufacturing highly uniform,
highly reliable slurry; (3) technology for precisely　stacking dielectric sheets; and (4)
technology for firing in a controlled atmosphere without oxidation. For high-capacity
products for AI/DC, we see the key factors as (1) materials development that increases the

crystallinity of dielectric materials while making them finer, in order to thin each dielectric
layer as much as possible (layer thinning), together with (2) manufacturing technology to
precisely stack the dielectric sheets.

Dielectric material manufacturing process
Dielectric materials are manufactured by adding a binder, solvent, and additives to barium
titanate (BaTiO3), which is produced from barium carbonate (B aCO3) and titanium oxide

(TiO2). Methods for manufacturing barium titanate are broadly divided into the solid-
phase method and the liquid-phase method. In the solid-phase method, barium carbonate
and titanium oxide are mixed and fired at high temperature, producing barium titanate
through a chemical reaction at the firing stage. In the liquid-phase method, barium
carbonate and titanium oxide are dissolved in a solution, reacted at the solution stage, and
fired at a relatively low temperature to produce the compound. Manufacturing methods

used in mass production via the liquid-phase method include the oxalate method and the
hydrothermal synthesis method. Barium titanate with small and uniform particle size is
key to smaller and higher-capacity MLCCs. In 2023, Murata established MF Materials, a
joint venture with Ishihara Sangyo and Ishihara Sangyo's wholly owned subsidiary Fuji
Titanium (with equity stakes of 20% for Murata, 10% for Ishihara Sangyo, and 70% for Fuji
Titanium). MF Materials produces barium titanate via the oxalate process and supplies it

to Murata Manufacturing.　MF Materials is constructing a new building adjacent to its head
office plant in Nobeoka, Miyazaki Prefecture, with operations scheduled to commence in
2027. TDK established a joint venture with Nippon Chemical Industrial in April 2026 called
TDK-NCI Advanced Materials (with equity stakes of 51% for TDK and 49% for Nippon
Chemical Industrial), with plans to accelerate development of the oxalate method barium
titanate.

What are the risks to Murata?
Risks for Murata include: (1) losing MLCC market share by failing to adequately supply
MLCCs for AI servers/DCs amid rapidly expanding demand. (2) Murata's products,
including MLCCs, are used not only in AI servers/DCs but across virtually all electronic
equipment, including automobiles, smartphones, and industrial machinery, making the
company sensitive to macroeconomic conditions and inventory cycles. (3) The company

has explained that a ¥1/$ appreciation of the yen would reduce operating profit by ¥4.5bn
per year, and the yen could appreciate beyond our assumed rate of ¥155/$, among other
factors.

Murata Manufacturing earnings forecasts
We expect Murata at 2Q results (end-Oct) to hike F3/27
guidance; continued earnings growth from F3/28
F3/27-28 and F3/27 2Q forecasts: We project F3/27 OP of ¥490.8bn (guidance ¥430bn,

That is because we expect profit in the Components segment to rise ¥186.2bn to ¥501.3bn
and losses in the Device & Modules segment to shrink by ¥24.1bn from -¥26.5bn to -

to shrink mainly due to the falling out of ¥43.8bn in Resonant goodwill impairment and

Murata’s share price risk/reward: Even though we raise our earnings estimates for

Murata, we lower our DCF-based price target from ¥12,500 to ¥11,000, mainly reflecting
an increase in our DCF model’s risk-free rate from 2.60% to 3.0%. Murata's share price has
fallen 41% year-to-date from its June 22 peak, and we see 53% upside over the next 12-18
months, maintain our OW rating, and designate the stock as our Top Pick in Japan's
electronic components industry. The reasons are as follows: (1) We forecast the dollar-
based shipment value of MLCCs, where Murata held the top global share of 40% in 2025,

to expand at a CAGR of 21% through 2031, with Murata continuing to gradually gain
market share. (2) Demand for MLCCs used in AI servers/DCs is likely to continue
expanding, and demand for small, high-capacity, high-value-added products, which Murata
has brought to market ahead of competitors, should grow substantially. (3) Outside of
MLCCs, we look for demand to expand for small, high-value-added products, including
secondary batteries for DC BBUs, power modules for vertical power delivery in AI servers,

and RF modules for smartphones, and then expand even further as edge AI devices

SEMCO earnings forecasts
Shawn Kim
AI-driven MLCC growth and pricing to drive sharp earnings
acceleration in FY27, with continued growth in FY28
FY26-28 forecasts: We project SEMCO OP of W2.34tn in FY26 (+156% YoY), W5.70tn in
FY27 and W8.36tn in FY28, implying further growth of 144% and 47%, respectively. We
expect the earnings acceleration to be driven mainly by the Components (MLCC) and
Package Solution businesses, while the Optics business remains a relatively modest

contributor. In FY27, our projected OP of W5.70tn breaks down as Components W4.56tn,
Package Solution W943bn, and Optics W201bn, versus W1.67tn, W510bn, and W165bn,
respectively, in FY26. In FY28, we forecast Components OP rising further to W6.55tn,
Package Solution to W1.58tn, and Optics to W230bn. As such, we expect SEMCO's consol.
OP margin to grow from 8.1% in FY25 to 15.7% in FY26, 24.5% in FY27, and 25.9% in FY28.
We maintain the stock as our top pick within our S. Korea Technology coverage.

For Components, we expect profit growth to accelerate as AI-server demand drives both
strong MLCC volume growth and a structurally richer product mix. High-end AI MLCC
supply remains tight, with lead times exceeding 20 weeks, supply-chain inventories lean
following two years of destocking, and book-to-bill at the three high-end suppliers
reaching its highest level since the pandemic. Importantly, contract pricing has increasingly
been institutionalized through long-term agreements, while the high-end AI MLCC market

remains concentrated, with Murata and SEMCO together holding around 85% share.
Capacity additions are also unlikely to close the supply-demand gap quickly, as most
meaningful new capacity is scheduled for 2027 or later and suppliers are generally
targeting only around 10-15% annual output growth. We thus expect tighter supply-
demand, higher pricing, and a shift toward high-capacitance, low-ESL AI products to drive
Components OP margin from 21.4% in FY26 to 30.9% in FY27 and 30.1% in FY28.

Bull case W3,000,000
Our bull case assumes ABF opportunities from major US CSPs drive stronger content
growth, with future ASIC content & volume growth continuing to outpace our base-case
expectations. Customer diversification toward non-mobile customers should also reduce
earnings volatility and improve profitability. Our bull case, equivalent to 15x FY27e P/B,
reflects what we see as an unprecedented super-cycle in the underlying AI-related MLCC

and ABF markets.
Bear case W1,350,000
In our bear case, we assume slower content growth in MLCCs and substrates due to
greater competition and China's localization, together with prolonged consumer weakness
weighing on the Optics business. However, we still expect increasing AI exposure to
structurally lift SEMCO's MLCC and ABF ASPs, product mix and margins, given the
difficulty commodity suppliers face in penetrating the premium market. Our bear-case

value corresponds to 7x FY27e P/B. Key downside risks include a significant pullback in

Samsung's mobile flagship cycle, lower SEMCO market share, execution risk in penetrating
Chinese smartphone customers, and continued consumer-demand weakness.

Morgan Stanley MUFG 25
Yageo earnings forecasts
Howard Kao
Tightening MLCC Narrative is Unchanged
We forecast CY26 revenue of approximately NT$183B, up 38% y/y, driven primarily by
stronger AI-related demand, with a more modest contribution from consumer
applications. This demand strength should support broad-based utilization improvement
across Yageo’s passive component portfolio. Pricing is also turning more favorable, with
distributor price increases implemented in 2Q26 and Yageo raising prices for direct

customers in 3Q26, as previously highlighted. The combination of higher utilization and
firmer pricing should drive meaningful operating leverage. We forecast gross margin
expanding to 39.3%, up 310bps y/y, and operating margin reaching 27.4%, up 500bps y/y,
supporting EPS of approximately NT$19.79.
Looking into CY27, we expect supply/demand conditions in the mid- and low-end markets
to tighten further, sustaining pricing momentum and driving an additional improvement in

utilization. We therefore forecast revenue of approximately NT$252B, up 38% y/y.
Continued operating leverage should lift gross margin to 43.2%, an increase of 390bps y/y,
and operating margin to 33.4%, up 600bps y/y, resulting in EPS of approximately NT$32.11.
Why has the stock been so volatile?
Yageo benefited from a sharp increase in MLCC pricing in 2Q26, driven by a temporary
spike in spot-market demand. In our view, ODM/EMS customers accelerated inventory

replenishment amid concerns that the ramp in high-end AI-server MLCC demand,
particularly alongside Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform, could constrain supply of mid- and
low-end MLCCs. Under normal market conditions, these customers typically carry only 3-4
weeks of inventory. However, supply concerns prompted a rapid increase in inventory
coverage to approximately 4-6 months.
During this restocking phase, ODM/EMS customers sourced MLCCs from both
manufacturers, including Yageo, and distributors. The resulting demand surge drove a

sharp increase in spot/distributor pricing and also contributed to the stock’s strong
performance. However, the pricing move was largely driven by a one-off inventory build.
Once customers had secured sufficient inventory, purchasing activity normalized and spot
pricing began to soften. This, together with weaker broader market sentiment, led to a
pullback of ~50% from the stock’s peak of approximately NT$1,140.
At the current share price, however, we believe the risk-reward has become attractive. The

underlying fundamentals, and, importantly, our view of the MLCC upcycle, remain intact.
Our analysis indicates substantial incremental demand for high-end, high-capacitance
MLCCs of 47µF and above, which will require a meaningful increase in dedicated
production capacity. We expect this to drive further capacity conversion toward high-end
MLCCs, with the resulting crowding-out effect becoming more visible from late CY26 into
early CY27. This should progressively tighten supply in the mid- and low-end MLCC

market and provide renewed support for pricing.

Price Target Discussion and Valuation Methodology
We lower our 12-month price target to NT$1,050 (from NT$1,465): This reflects our
lower earnings estimates for CY26-28. Our price target is our base case value, derived
from our residual income valuation model. Similar to our analysis of other tech hardware
companies within our coverage, we think this methodology provides the most accurate

value of the firm by taking into account the cost of equity.
Our key assumptions are:
• Cost of equity of 7.8%:
° Risk-free rate of 1.0% (10-year Taiwanese government bond yield);
° Equity risk premium of 6.8%;
° Beta of 1.1;

• Medium-term growth rate of 12% (down from 16%);
• Terminal growth rate of 3%.
Our price target implies 33x 2027e P/E and 24x 2028e P/E. These are above its five-year
historical range of 8x to 18x, which we view as justified considering its longer-term
transformation story to become a global total solutions provider, moving from passive
into active components. In addition, compared to global passive component peers, we

believe Yageo stock remains undervalued with higher ROE and margins but lower P/E vs.
Japanese peers (which trade on an average at 40x+ P/E).
Our bull and bear case scenario values decrease by magnitudes similar to the change
to our base case value, to NT$1,490 and NT$480, respectively.

Taiyo Yuden earnings forecasts
We expect expect record profit in F3/29, not F3/28; upgrade
the stock from UW to EW
Full-term F3/27 and F3/28 earnings forecasts, F3/27 2Q forecasts: We project F3/27 OP
of ¥45.1bn (guidance ¥45bn, FactSet consensus ¥42bn), up +¥25.1bn YoY. We expect sales
in dollars of core product capacitors (MLCCs) to increase +22.6% YoY (+27.4% on yen
basis), a continued increase following on FY3/26’s +10.4% rise (+8.5% on yen basis), and

higher utilization rates absorbing increased depreciation expense and other fixed cost
increases. We project F3/28 OP of ¥66.1bn (consensus ¥73.1bn), up +¥25bn YoY. We look
for sales in dollars of capacitors (MLCCs) to rise +17.3% YoY (+16.6% on a yen basis),
absorbing increased depreciation expense and other fixed cost increases. We expect OP to
rise ¥83.8bn in F3/29 (consensus ¥107.1bn), surpassing the historical high profit of
¥68.2bn in F3/22.

We project 2Q OP of ¥12.6bn (consensus ¥11bn), up +¥7.8bn from ¥4.8bn in 1Q. We look
for MLCC sales to rise +18.1% compared with 1Q and for the utilization rate to rise from
85% in 1Q to 95% in 2Q. With increased sales of inductors for North American
smartphones, there should be a major profit increase on 1Q.

Taiyo Yuden share price risk/reward: We upgrade Taiyo Yuden from UW to EW, as we
believe its share price, having fallen 56.0% from its July 1 peak, has limited downside risk

and offers 6% upside over the next 12-18 months. We lower our DCF-based price target
from ¥12,500 to ¥10,500. This mainly reflects an increase in the DCF model’s risk-free
rate from 2.60% to 3.0%. We rate the stock EW rather than OW because: (1) In its core
MLCC business, we estimate Taiyo Yuden's MLCC market share was 11.3% in 2025, down
from 12.7% in 2020, and we think this downtrend continued into 2026, with its market
share shrinking to 10.7% in 1Q and 9.9% in 2Q. (2) We believe Taiyo Yuden is lagging

behind Murata (No. 1 share) and SEMCO (No. 2) in small, high-capacity MLCCs for AI
server accelerator boards, where demand is rapidly expanding. (3) We expect consensus
estimates for F3/28 onward to be revised down after 2Q results.
Bull case ¥14,000, 49% projected upside
In our bull case, F3/27 sales of MLCCs for AI servers/data centers are 7% higher than in our
base case, for OP of ¥56.5bn in F3/27, ¥85.5bn in F3/28, and ¥176.3bn in F3/31. Our forex

assumptions and DCF assumptions match our base case. Bull case fair value corresponds
to 50.7x our fully-diluted F3/27 EPS estimate of ¥276.1, 33.6x our fully-diluted F3/28 EPS
estimate of ¥417.0, and 15.9x our full-diluted F3/31 EPS estimate of ¥879.1.
Bear case ¥4,500
Taiyo Yuden’s care products (MLCCs and inductors) are used in all kinds of electronic
devices, and are easily affected by the macro economy and inventory cycle. In our bear
case, we assume slower global economic growth rates and lower production of high-end

consumer goods like high-end smartphones than in our base case, for OP of ¥39.2bn in
F3/27, ¥56.1bn in F3/28, and ¥65.8bn in F3/31. Our forex assumptions and DCF
assumptions are the same as in our base case. Here we look for ROE of 7.3% in F3/27 and
10.1% in F3/28, improving to a level above capital cost of 7.9%. With profit below market
expectations, we assume the share price falls to a P/B of 1.8x.

First Read
Voltronic Power
UBS Taiwan Summit 2026 key takeaways:
Earnings growth hinges on UPS/HVDC deliveries
Sales turning to growth in H226; sales mix change driving margin expansion
Management indicated bookings and shipments remained solid in July-Aug despite
temporary PCB shortages, and it expects a sales turnaround to growth in H226. Inverter
sales could stay weak on competition and Voltronic's product portfolio adjustments

(reducing low-margin products). Meanwhile, increasing outsourcing by brands will
support UPS sales growth. Management expects HVDC products to start contributing in
2027. Voltronic added a third customer for HVDC products. We think a higher sales
portion from UPS/HVDC products and inverter product adjustments could bring GM
expansion in 2027.
UPS growth intact;  HVDC and PDU represent the next legs of growth
The company expects sales to resume growth by single digits  in H226  and expects >10%

YoY growth in 2027. Management remains cautious about solar  inverters due to intense
competition from Chinese peers and expects inverter sales to decline as Voltronic adjusts
its product portfolio, focusing more on commercial solar  and premium products. For
2027, management expects offline UPS to grow 0-5%, supported by outsourcing
opportunities and emerging market demand, which could offset notebook weakness.
High-power UPS could account for an increasingly higher sales portion, driven by

accelerating outsourcing by tier 1 customers. For HVDC, management highlighted it
obtained one more client. HVDC product progress is on schedule, with 800VDC power
shelf sampling expected by year-end, a pilot run in H127 and mass production in H227.
The company is preparing testing and production equipment at factories in Taiwan and
China. Over the longer term, management also sees opportunities in PDUs, a market it
estimates at US$5bn in 2025, with a 12-15% sales CAGR over the next 5-8 years.

Margin  improvement on product mix optimisation and higher prices
Voltronic has implemented two UPS price increases this year to offset higher raw
material costs, which it expects to be reflected on its P&L starting in Sept 2026. For solar
inverters, management plans to focus on higher power and premium products with a
GM above 20%, while reducing low-power products with a GM at or below 20% over
the next two to three quarters, which could support GM expansion. In upcoming

quarters, solar inverter products may shrink to <20% of the total sales mix, while higher-
margin businesses such as high-power UPS and HVDC products continue to ramp. We
think the sales mix change will expand margins in 2027.
Valuation: Maintain Buy rating and PT of NT$1,128
We maintain our Buy rating and price target of NT$1,128, based on sum-of-the-parts
analysis, applying 28x/23x/24x 2027E PE for UPS/inverter/PSU business, respectively.

Company Description
Founded in 2008, Voltronic is a leading ODM for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) and
inverters. Its major customers include Schneider, Vertiv, and Riello. Voltronic is headquartered
in Taiwan and has production plants in mainland China, Vietnam, and Taiwan.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement

We base our price target on sum of the parts.
We believe the key risks for Voltronic include: 1) a slower-than-expected outsourcing trend
from leading branded UPS companies; 2) a faster-than-expected ramp-up of the electricity
grid in developing countries resulting in lower-than-expected demand for off-grid solar
systems; 3) FX risks; and 4) rising raw material prices.
Key industry-specific risks include: 1) unexpected changes in the underlying global

macroeconomic environment; 2) currency and interest rate movement; and 3) commodity
price inflation.

Investing in structured investments involves significant risks. For a detailed discussion of the risks involved in investing in any particular structured investment, you must read

the relevant offering materials for that investment. Structured investments are unsecured obligations of a particular issuer with returns linked to the performance of an
underlying asset. Depending on the terms of the investment, investors could lose all or a substantial portion of their investment based on the performance of the underlying
asset. Investors could also lose their entire investment if the issuer becomes insolvent. UBS does not guarantee in any way the obligations or the financial condition of any

issuer or the accuracy of any financial information provided by any issuer. Structured investments are not traditional investments and investing in a structured investment is
not equivalent to investing directly in the underlying asset. Structured investments may have limited or no liquidity, and investors should be prepared to hold their investment
to maturity. The return of structured investments may be limited by a maximum gain, participation rate or other feature. Structured investments may include call features and,

if a structured investment is called early, investors would not earn any further return and may not be able to reinvest in similar investments with similar terms. Structured
investments include costs and fees which are generally embedded in the price of the investment. The tax treatment of a structured investment may be complex and may differ
from a direct investment in the underlying asset. UBS and its employees do not provide tax advice. Investors should consult their own tax advisor about their own tax situation

before investing in any securities.

### Page 3

We see several indicators suggesting strong ABF equipment demand, including (1) the 
lead time for ABF vacuum laminators has extended into 2031, implying ~1.5k units of 
mid-to-high end equipment orders (assuming UTR is full for Eternal Precision’s capacity 
in both Japan and China throughout 2027-31), vs. ~600 units of total equipment 
shipped during 2022-25. This suggests demand for ABF equipment is strengthening 
(even stronger than previous upcycle in 2020-22) and shifting toward higher-end 
(management mentioned that the four major Taiwanese ABF customers mainly ordered 
the 90-ton 3-stage vacuum laminators for new capacity expansions), (2) Eternal 
Precision has seen some customers voluntarily offer to pay a premium to secure 
equipment supply and shorten the long lead time, a trend that was not observed by the 
company during the last upcycle, and (3) contract liabilities uptrend has just started 
(Exhibit 2), and we expect to see even stronger growth in coming years considering the 
upcoming ABF substrate industry capacity expansion trend (from 2027 to at least 2031, 
Exhibit 3) 
The extended order lead time for the key ABF equipment supports our positive view on 
the ABF substrate industry. ABF suppliers remain proactive in capacity expansion, but 
demand continues to outpace supply, thus we expect the shortage ratio of ABF 
substrates could reach 14%/34%/51% in 2H26/2027/2028 (see here). We see limited 
risk from capacity expansion by China ABF suppliers due to their limited access to new 
ABF equipment. Eternal Precision has seen some China ABF customers offering 
premiums to shorten equipment lead time, but the company mentioned that they 
prioritize major customers, as well as those with secured ABF film supply (we continue to 
see limitations on ABF film supply for China ABF suppliers). Meanwhile, more 
end-customers are asking key ABF suppliers for capacity beyond 2029, consistent with 
the fact that major ABF suppliers have better access to key ABF equipment. 
In terms of future substrate products, Unimicron previously mentioned that MP 
shipment of EMIB-T substrates could start in 2027 (see here). While Japanese ABF 
suppliers will be the first to have access to the new ABF vacuum laminators for EMIB-T 
substrates given their better production yields, Unimicron is tracking close by targeting a 
50% yield for this new product. For the more advanced glass core substrates, we 
continue to see Kinsus and Unimicron making progress with this new technology (see 
here and here), while commercialization is unlikely in the near term (beyond 2029 per 
GSe). Overall, we believe that the most advanced packaging substrates could become a 
key revenue/GM driver in the longer term given their better pricing/margin profile (most 
advanced packaging substrates typically have GM of 60%+ upon MP vs. 
Kinsus/Unimicron GM at 26.1%/24.8% as of 2Q26). 
Maintain our Buy ratings on NYPCB (on CL) and Kinsus, but stay Neutral on Unimicron, 
with unchanged 12m TPs for NYPCB/Kinsus/Unimicron of 
NT$2,500/NT$1,125/NT$1,220.  
Investment Thesis & PT methodology and risks

Investment Thesis - NYPCB 
NYPCB manufactures and markets printed circuit boards (PCBs) and integrated circuit 
(IC) substrates (including ABF and BT substrates). We are Buy-rated on NYPCB

### Page 4

considering the company’s high exposure to BT substrates and non-LTA ABF substrate
(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the
coming quarters (from breakeven in OPM in 1H25 to 27/41% in 2026/27E) due to the
favorable substrate pricing outlook. Despite the company’s low exposure to high-end
ABF substrate industry (<20% of total revenue in 1H25), we believe the expanding
demand from ASIC AI server and high-end switch IC demand will drive the company’s

high-end ABF revenue exposure to 40%+ by 2027E, suggesting better GM/OPM outlook
in the long term. In 2H25-2H26, we believe NYPCB will continue to benefit from stronger
ABF/BT pricing and should be a key beneficiary of the pricing uptrend considering the
company’s key focus on BT and non-LTA ABF substrate industries. Moreover, in the long
term (after 2026), we expect the ABF industry to return to supply tightness, and NYPCB’s
expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long-term earnings growth outlook (122%

2026-28E earnings CAGR). As a result, we see solid upside potential for NYPCB’s
earnings and stock performance.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - NYPCB
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$2,500 for NYPCB is based
on 21x 2028E P/E, which is +1.5x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E (13.3x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, and (3)

Slower-than-expected NYPCB new high-end capacity qualification progress.
Investment Thesis - Kinsus
Kinsus is one of the key IC substrates suppliers globally with ~10% ABF/BT substrates
market share in 2024, with ~18% of total 2025 revenue contributed by its contact lens
subsidiary, Pegavision (6941.TW, Not Covered). With our view that the ABF substrate
shortage started from 2Q26 (ABF substrate return to supply demand balance from late
2025), we believe Kinsus’ performance will continue to improve compared with high-end

ABF peers considering the company’s increasing market share in the high-end ABF
substrate market; however, ~36% of the company’s revenue was contributed by BT
substrates in 2025 and 30% of the company’s ABF revenue is from non-LTA customers,
which we believe will continue to enjoy a better pricing outlook. As a result, we believe
Kinsus’ earnings outlook should continue to be strong (~106% 2026-29E CAGR), mainly
driven by better BT substrate and non-LTA ABF substrate pricing outlook, despite the

unfavorable demand outlook before 2H26. We believe Kinsus is an experienced
substrate supplier with a clear capacity expansion plan that can also upgrade its product
portfolio in the long term. We believe we are at the beginning of an industry upcycle,
making us positive on Kinsus’ stock performance over the next 12 months.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Kinsus
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,125 for Kinsus is based on

16.5x 2028E P/E, which is +1.2x STDV higher than Kinsus’ past upcycle average P/E
(14.2x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, (3)
Slower/Less-than-expected AI server orders from 2H26.

### Page 5

Investment Thesis - Unimicron Technology
Unimicron is a key supplier of ABF substrates (25% market share in 2025) and BT
substrates and also produces FPC/HDI/PCB products. We are Neutral rated on the
shares given long-term growth opportunity prospects: (1) over 70% of ABF shipments
are covered by long-term agreements (LTA), which limits pricing flexibility and makes
price hike less likely; (2) the company’s execution track record has been weaker than

peers; (3) capacity expansion plan remains slower than peers, constraining its ability to
capture incremental AI demand. The current ABF substrates market is seeing more
favorable supply demand outlook, and Unimicron is likely to see better pricing outlook
to reflect rising material costs in the coming quarters. AI ABF account for 10% of the
company’s total revenue, but the growth is likely to be slower than peers due to the
company continuing to lose market share to peers given its less favourable production

yield and slow capacity expansion. Overall, we are Neutral rated on Unimicron given our
outlook for limited upside potential, barring ASIC AI servers, despite our generally
positive view in the long term on its profitability trajectory.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Unimicron Technology
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,220 for Unimicron is
based on 17.4x 2028E P/E, which is 2.7x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E

(10.3x).
Key upside/downside risks: (1) Slower/faster-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower/faster-than-expected ABF substrates upgrading pace, and (3) Slower/faster
than-expected AI server PCB market share loss progress.

### Page 3

Taiwan Electronic Components & Equipment
17 September 2026 Citi Research
3
Asia Vital Components (3017.TW)
Buy | TP NT$4,350.00 from NT$3,800.00 | Price NT$3,185.00 (17 Sep 26 13:30)
Sequential growth intact, ASIC carrying the upside — Our checks and mgmt.
comments indicate Vera Rubin platform has begun contributing in small volumes
from Sep, with a further ramp expected in 4Q26E. The ongoing ASIC project is now
shifting progressively from air cooling to liquid cooling, while another ASIC project

enters mass production in 4Q26E, together the main growth drivers as new
capacity comes online through the quarter. We now forecast 3Q26E/4Q26E
revenue growth at 18%/12% QoQ. GPM should also improve on a sequential basis,
supported by yield improvement and a rising contribution from server and liquid
cooling products.
ASIC contribution could exceed 50% of liquid cooling revenue in 2027 — With
cold plate demand continuing to run ahead of supply, we expect AVC to undertake

another round of capacity expansion in 2027 to meet rising ASIC demand,
consistent with mgmt. ’s view that ASIC contribution catches up with GPU in 2027.
We also note ongoing discussion around double-sided cold plate adoption, with
several platforms at the R&D stage, which we see as a source of upside
momentum. Rubin Ultra spec remains under development, and we do not expect
the potential TDP adjustments toward a lower level to affect content value, as cold

plate content is driven more by design than by chip TDP itself. On a higher liquid
cooling contribution, we forecast 2027E revenue to grow another 50% YoY, with
GPM to further increase to 34.9% (+2.2ppts YoY).
Implications — We raise our 2026E/27E/28E earnings forecasts by 3%/13%/16% to
reflect the updated outlook, driven mainly by higher cold plate capacity and
shipment assumptions alongside a more constructive view on ASIC liquid cooling
demand. Our revised target price of NT$4,350 (from NT$3,800) remains based on

25x 2027E EPS. Given AVC’s position in the thermal sector and its valuation
following the recent share price pullback, we see a favorable risk-reward profile and
reiterate our Buy rating.

Auras Technology (3324.TWO)
Buy | TP NT$1,800.00 from NT$1,550.00 | Price NT$1,385.00 (17 Sep 26 15:00)
Liquid cooling ramp drives sequential acceleration into 4Q26 — Following Aug-
26 revenue, which pulled back from a high base in Jul-26, we believe Auras remains
on track to meet mgmt. ’s earlier guidance of at least 15% QoQ growth in 3Q26E.
Into 4Q26, shipments of Vera Rubin products, including inner/rack manifolds,

together with the start of mass production for liquid cooling version of ASIC
project, should allow Auras to deliver another solid sequential growth. We now
forecast 3Q26E/4Q26E revenue growth of 17%/16% QoQ, with GPM also on an
upward trend, supported by a higher liquid cooling revenue mix.
GPU & ASIC projects broaden the 2027 growth base — Our checks and mgmt.
comments  indicate Auras is still working through cold plate qualification for the
Vera Rubin platform and is now participating in next generation product

development. Given its operating scale, we believe even a modest share gain could
contribute meaningfully to its top line, and we expect the earliest potential
contribution from 1Q27E. Auras should also benefit from rising ASIC liquid cooling
demand, with existing ASIC project shipments to expand above 4Q26E levels and
several further projects now under discussion. We forecast 2027E revenue growth
of 35% YoY, with liquid cooling mix rising from 61% in 2026E to 70% in 2027E and

GPM reaching 31.3% (+1.2ppts YoY).
Implications — We raise our 2026E/27E/28E earnings forecasts by 2%/14%/17% to
reflect the updated outlook, driven mainly by higher cold plate shipment
assumptions alongside a more constructive view on ASIC liquid cooling demand.
Our revised target price of NT$1,800 (from NT$1,550) remains based on 20x 2027E
EPS. Given Auras’ structural growth in the server business, widening liquid cooling
content across both GPU and ASIC platforms, and an optimizing global

manufacturing footprint in Thailand, we view the current valuation as attractive
and reiterate our Buy rating.

Asia Vital Components
Company description
Asia Vital Components (AVC), founded in 1991, is a global leader in thermal
solutions, originally focusing on PCs but now specializing in servers and
networking. With Furukawa Electric (Japan) as its largest shareholder, AVC
provides a comprehensive range of cooling components, including vapor
chambers (VCs), fans, cold plates, CDUs, and manifolds, as well as chassis

and assembly services for PCs and servers, enabling holistic thermal solution
designs and one-stop shop services. AVC's diverse product portfolio supports
various sectors, including consumer IT, cloud infrastructure, transportation,
energy and networking.
Investment strategy
We rate AVC a Buy. AVC is well-positioned for the liquid-cooling transition,
with leadership in cold plates and broad participation across Nvidia and CSP
projects. Its high-volume machining capability, manufacturing uniformity,

and Vietnam-based capacity provide it with a defensible position as
Blackwell and future deployments expand. The company captures a wider
share of the thermal BOM, across coldplates, manifolds, QDs, and CDU
opportunities, providing a multi-layered earnings engine.
Valuation
We value AVC using a PE-based approach that factors in earnings momentum
and the expansion of its addressable market. Our TP of NT$4,350 is derived
from applying a 25x PE multiple on 2027E EPS, which we believe is justified

given the company’s entrenched positioned in the server thermal segment,
rising contribution from liquid cooling, and the increasing value of thermal
content per server as power density continues to climb. With these structural
drivers still in place, we expect the multiple to hold at a premium relative to its
historical averages.
Risks
This stock is High Risk based upon our quantitative model but assigning a
High Risk rating is not supported by other qualitative factors such as cold-

plate leadership and deep CSP penetration, and so a High Risk rating has not
been applied. Key downside risks to our investment thesis and target price
include: 1) slower adoption pace for liquid cooling adoption; 2) heightened
price competition; 3) lower-than-expected share in liquid cooling
components; and 4) emerging alternative cooling technologies.
Auras Technology
Company description
Auras Technology was founded in 1998 and focused on the design and

manufacturing of thermal modules for NB/PCs. It quickly became one of
Taiwan’s top two NB cooling component suppliers. Early products included
heatsinks, fins, heat pipes, and fans for NBs, PCs, and smartphones. As
device form factor evolved, the company invested in new technologies such
Prepared for Kevin Lu

### Page 12

Taiwan Electronic Components & Equipment
17 September 2026 Citi Research
12
as ultra-thin vapor chamber in the 2000s to address the thermal challenges
of increasingly compact consumer electronics. During the 2010s, Auras
expanded into graphic card and server cooling and was an early adopter of
liquid cooling technology. By 2012, the company had begun developing liquid
cooling component and was among the first Taiwanese firms to venture into
AI server liquid cooling.

Investment strategy
We rate Auras a Buy. Auras is emerging as a key liquid-cooling supplier as
hyperscalers expand deployment. The company has secured qualifications for
cold plates and manifolds, opening access to a wider slate of Nvidia and CSP
projects. Thailand-based production offers non-China capacity at a scale
aligned with hyperscaler sourcing plans, allowing Auras to compete more
effectively for next-generation products.
Valuation
We value Auras using a PE-based approach, reflecting its accelerating

earnings trajectory and rising share in liquid cooling market of AI servers. Our
TP of NT$1,800 is based on 20x 2027E EPS, which we believe is justified
given the company’s expanding server revenue base, deeper engagement
with CSP customers, and broader product portfolio across cold plates, CDMs,
and CDUs.
Risks
This stock is High Risk based upon our quantitative model, but assigning a
High Risk rating is not supported in our view by other qualitative factors such

as rapid RVL progress and Thailand expansion, and so a High Risk rating has
not been applied. Key downside risks to our investment thesis and target
price include: 1) slower adoption of liquid cooling; 2) heightened price
competition; 3) lower-than-expected share in liquid cooling components;
and 4) emerging alternative cooling technologies.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.
Catalyst Watch/Short Term Views (“STV”) Ratings Disclosure:

Catalyst Watch and STV Upside/Downside calls: Citi Research may also include a Catalyst Watch or STV Upside or Downside
call to indicate the analyst expects the share price to rise (fall) in absolute terms over a specified period of 30 or 90 days in
reaction to one or more specific near-term catalysts or events impacting the company or the market. A Catalyst Watch will be
published when Analyst confidence is high that an impact to share price will occur; it will be a STV when confidence level is

moderate. A Catalyst Watch or STV Upside/Downside call will automatically expire at the end of the specified 30/90 day
period. The Catalyst Watch will also be automatically removed if share price performance (calculated at market close) exceeds
15% against the direction of the call (unless over-ridden by the analyst). The analyst may also remove a Catalyst Watch or STV
call prior to the end of the specified period in a published research note. A Catalyst Watch/STV Upside or Downside call may be

our ratings distribution table for our Catalyst Watch/STV Upside/Downside rating system. However, we reiterate that we do
not consider No View to be a recommendation. For all Catalyst Watch/STV Upside/Downside calls, risk exists that the
catalyst(s) and associated share-price movement will not materialize as expected.

ab 18 September 2026
Global Research
First Read
Accton Technology Corporation
GM headwind should be lifted from Q426E
Revenue growth  remains on track despite component  consignment transition
We met  with Accton  earlier this week. Management remains confident that both Sept.
and Q426F sales will increase sequentially, supported by strong  demand for 800G
switches and the ramp-up of AI cards (i.e. Trainium 3), despite the transition of certain
components (memory and PCB) to a consignment model. We  estimate the consignment

shift reduced   Aug. sales by ~5%  and now forecast Q326E sales of NT$122.5 bn, up
28% QoQ (vs  prior +30% QoQ). Accton noted  it had prepaid for the higher-cost
components on behalf of  customers in the recent months to secure  supply availability,
but discussion regarding the reimbursement terms  remain ongoing. Given the timing
mismatch, its conservative accounting approach, and a higher sales mix from AI card, we
expect Q326E GM to decline 1.4 ppt QoQ to 18.3%, while OPM should remain relatively

resilient  on operating leverage. We forecast Q326E EPS of NT$25.39, up 29% QoQ.
GM recovery likely  from Q426E with higher content from liquid cooling
We forecast Q426E sales growth of 3% QoQ, supported by continued strength in  800G
switches and the ongoing ramp of Trainium 3. We expect one of the Trainium 3 models
will migrate from air cooled to liquid-cooled design, which carry ~20% higher ASP and
better GM due to increased design complexity. To strength its competitive positioning

and capture more value add,  Accton is expanding its in-house manufacturing
capabilities for the liquid-cooling components at its Malaysia facility. We expect liquid-
cooling adoption to accelerate across both Trainium 3 and next-gen Trainium 4, for
which we believe all models will adopt liquid cooling, given  better heat dissipation,
along with improving quality/yield for liquid cooling components.
Multiple drivers supporting 2027E growth
We see several catalysts supporting continued  growth into 2027E. Key drivers include:

(1) further Trainium 3 ramp with higher ASP for liquid cooling, (2) sustained 800G switch
demand with adoption of  new  platforms based on Marvell and Spectrum chipsets, (3)
migration to 1.6T switch, and (4) increasing  contribution from Optical Switch. We expect
its AI card business will grow ~50% YoY  in 2027E, after ~45% growth in 2026E, while
revenue contribution from social media customer to increase from low-teens % of sales
this year to mid-teens % in 2027E. Beyond existing customers, it is engaging with

additional  CSPs for potential 2027 pilot and the  L11 server rack has started initial
shipments in 2026, which should see more contribution in 2027E.
Valuation:Reiterate Buy with PT of NT$3,688
We lower  2026E EPS by 2%  but raise 2027-28E EPS by 2-3% to reflect the temporary
GM headwind offset by  higher contribution from liquid cooling AI card business. We
retain Buy rating with PT of NT$3,688, based on 26x average 2027-28E PE.  We believe
recent concern on component shortages and  lower margin on higher component cost is

overdone as we believe Accton's GM should gradually recover from Q426E.

Company Description
Founded in 1988, Accton specialises in ODM/OEM solutions for data center switches, AI
accelerator cards, enterprise/ODM switches, carrier access/telecom and others. Accton is one
of the largest vendors of white-box and OCP-compliant switches globally (by sales).

Leveraging deep expertise in high-speed switching, system integration and rapid time-to-
market, it has secured long-term partnerships with major cloud service providers.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Accton using PE methodology.
Key risks include: 1) weaker-than-expected demand for data center switches; 2) slower ramp
of 800G and 1.6T data center switches; 3) market share loss in the AI accelerator card
business; and 4) softer gross margin than expected.

Bizlink  | Asia Pacific
Partnership with ams OSRAM
for Breakthrough Optical
Interconnect Solution
This partnership represents another effort for Bizlink in
diversifying its data interconnect solutions across both the
copper and optical space.
What's new:
• Bizlink announced it will partner with ams OSRAM on next-generation
optical interconnects for the scale-up network.
• The solution will leverage ams OSRAM's 850nm thin-film micro VCSEL

technology (in 25um pitch array) and Bizlink's expertise in fiber-array
integration, optical packaging, and volume production, featuring low latency,
lower power (0.25pJ/bit), wide and slow (32 Gbps), reliable (no failures after
2,000+ hours of testing under stressed conditions), scalable  and
connectorized architecture.
• A demonstration of this solution  will be showcased in the upcoming ECOC
2026 conference in Spain.
Our view:
• We think the industry continues to seek innovative ways of solving the

power consumption issue in data interconnects, including the relocation of
the optical engines (e.g., NPO/CPO) and the alternative light sources (e.g.,
micro LED and micro VCSEL).
• This represent another effort from Bizlink to diversify its data interconnect
solutions across both the copper and optical space, which could help reduce
the risk of technology disruptions.
• We thus see positive implications to Bizlink from this in the mid to long term,

though the revenue contribution might take time.
• Stay constructive on Bizlink for its multiple drivers in the AI deployment
theme, including data/power interconnects and semi cap equipment.

12-18 months.

欣興 (3037 TT) 
ABF 漲幅優於預期，獲利再度上修

永豐觀點 
3Q26 欣興 ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點，中線T-glass 玻纖布於 3Q27 前
供給吃緊，長線 ABF 供不應求至 2030 年，載板報價可望逐季推升 5-15%，獲利
持續高速成長，近期股價下跌反應檢調搜索利空，評價已修正至合理區間。 
 投資評價與建議 
欣興受惠 ABF 帶動產品組合轉佳，長線而言 ABF 於 2030 年前供給吃緊，載板報
價漲勢由成本推升改為需求拉動，3Q26 漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點，且本波循環
公司通吃 CoWoS 及 EMIB-T 訂單，客戶遍及 GPU、ASIC 及 CPU 訂單，技術能
力僅次於龍頭廠 Ibiden， 研究部再度上調2026-2028 年稅後 EPS 至 23.57、42.71
及 65.08 元，投資建議買進，考量檢調風波對評價承壓，目標價維持 1575 元
(24X2028 EPS)。

ESG 評析 
欣興企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 B+等與 A 等。 
SinoPac+ ESG 評鑑系統評等

資料來源：SinoPac+ ESG 評等 (依循 2023 SinoPac+企業永續評鑑方法學)

專業意見，對於評分結果及評估報告內容之完整性及真實性，不負擔保責任，亦不對閱讀或使用
本評估報告之第三方負任何責任。

2

欣興為國內 ABF 龍頭廠商：欣興為國內專業 IC 載板製造商，全球市佔率 18%僅
次於 Ibiden 以及 Samsung，2Q26 產品組合為 ABF(52%)、BT(9%)、HDI(27%)、
PCB(9%)、FPC(2%)及其它(1%)，其中 IC 載板毛利率優於公司平均水準。下游客
戶包含 Nokia、APPLE、Nvidia 以及 HTC，主要競爭對手為 Ibiden、Samsung、
Shinko、南電以及景碩。 
3Q26 營收達成率 69.6%， 暗示ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 ：欣興 8 月營收來到 177.46
億元(+9.2%MoM，+56.3%YoY)，除延續自 3 月以來月月創高紀錄外值得留意的
是月增及年增幅度亦同步擴大，整體 3Q26 營收達成率 69.6%亦優於原預期，暗
示 ABF 報價漲幅優於預期 10 個百分點以上，研究部上調3Q26 營收至 525.83 億
元(+22.6%QoQ，+54.7%YoY)， 毛利率25.8%， 稅後淨利93.36 億元(-28.8%QoQ，
+325.4%YoY)，稅後 EPS 5.68 元(原估 5.26 元)。 
CPU 生命週期展開使 ABF 需求更具延續性：過去 ABF 需求主要聚焦 AI Server 需
求，研究部原預估 2024-2025 年 ABF 供過於求 2%，2026 年亦難見反轉。受惠
AI Server 於 GPU 及 ASIC 需求帶動，另一方面 general server 回溫有望使 ABF
需求由高階產品延續至中階產品，Ibiden 預估相關高階 ABF 需求高速成長，加計
Production load 換算 2028 年面積需求較 2024 年增加 10.7 倍 ， 相較AI/ASIC 產
能於 2028 年擴充 1.8 倍供給仍低於需求。 
檢調搜索風波影響營運有限：日前欣興合江廠遭檢調搜索，股價亦應聲下跌，研究
部認為欣興合江廠位於中壢，主要生產 PCB 產品 2Q26 營收占比 9%，雖然後續
可能因產地標示不明影響 PCB 客戶關係 ， 惟與目前主力營運ABF 載板以及 HDI 並
無關聯。ABF 在 AI Server 需求推動下 2030 年以前供不應求，目前高階 GPU、
ASIC 產品僅 Ibiden(4062 JP)及欣興(3037 TT)具備相關供應能力，自研 CPU 則有
景碩(3189 TT) 緊追在後，考量產品認證需時 6-8 個月、關鍵壓合機台 lead time
亦 1-1.5 年，短期轉單不易。 
ABF 報價優於預期，上調 2026-2028 年營運：欣興 2026 年資本支出 537 億元，
其中 85%用於 ABF 除搭配客戶陸續啟動光復及楊梅 2 廠擴產，楊梅 3 廠可望於
4Q26-1Q27 動土，以土建時程 1.5-2 年推算 2029 年可望加入營運行列，未來 2
年資本支出亦可望維持 400 億以上水準。研究部考量 ABF 整體供給吃緊態勢延續
以及公司通吃 CoWoS 及 EMIB-T 產品，先進封裝客戶群布局廣泛，研究部上調

3231 緯創資通(WISTRON)

報告日期 ：2026/09/11           研究員 ： 曾智楷(Kevin Tseng) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一、 2Q26 獲利優於預期，毛利率 5.66% 
緯創 2Q26 營收 8954 億，QoQ +5.8% ，YoY +62.4% ，獲利方面，
2Q26 營業毛利 506.6 億， QoQ +14.9% ，YoY +107.2% ，毛利率
5.66% ，QoQ +0.45ppts ，YoY +1.22ppts ，營業利益 334.5 億，
QoQ +14.8% ，YoY +210.1% ，營利率 3.74% ，QoQ +0.3ppts ，
YoY +1.78ppts ，業外淨損 23.63 億，稅後淨利 148 億， QoQ 
+54% ，YOY +128% ，單季稅後 EPS 4.66 元，創單季新高。

二、受惠 AI 需求續強，，挹注下半年營收動能  
公司公告 8 月營收 4600.65 億， MoM +49.3% ，YoY +166.5% ，
今年累計營收 2.51 兆， YoY +98.9% 。展望 2H26 ，公司表示 AI
需求依舊非常強勁，受惠於新客戶以及新產品線的加入，預期 AI
伺服器下半年出貨量及營收表現將優於上半年。通用型伺服器則
預期下半年出貨持平。針對第三季新舊平台交替，公司表示，新
一代 Vera Rubin 已經開始出貨，且 GB 系列下半年仍有客戶持續
採購，並未出現新舊產品迭代的空窗期。而筆電部分，公司則是
表示，由於上半年 PC 客戶提前拉貨影響，預估下半年筆電出貨
量將較上半年衰退 10~20% 。預估公司 3Q26 營收 1.16 兆， QoQ 
+29.8% ，YoY +104.7% ，毛利率 5.7% ，營利率 3.6% ，稅後淨利
163.4 億，單季稅後 EPS 5.14 元。

三、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 18.02/22.70 元 
展望 2026 年，公司預估， 2026 年 AI 伺服器的出貨將呈現倍增，
除了既有主要 Enterprise 客戶需求成長之外，下半年將進一步加
入新的 Enterprise 客戶與新的 CSP 客戶。而就新產品進度而言，
NVIDIA 新一代 VR 已經開始量產， CPU 機櫃、 LPU 機櫃、交換
器及儲存設備也會在下半年陸續出貨。此外， AMD MI450 系列也
會在下半年開始出貨。另外，網通方面，交換器 (Switch) 已開始出
貨給客戶，維持今年出貨量成長 10 倍以上預期，將有助於公司產
品組合的持續優化。此外，公司表示，受惠於客戶結構走向多元
化，有助於公司整體利潤率的提升。預估公司 2026 年全年營收
4.07 兆， YoY +86.5% ，毛利率 5.5% ，營利率 3.5% ，稅後淨利
572.9 億，全年稅後 EPS18.02 元。而就明年來看，公司對 2027
年展望持樂觀態度，由於新一代產品放量主要會落在 2027 年，再
加上交換機出貨亦將持續增加，並將推出 800G 、1.6T 等新規格

四、投資建議為「買進」，目標價 270 元 
考量到美系 CSP 資本支出展望正向，公司 AI 產品需求維持強勁
成長動能，且隨著公司新客戶以及新產品線的加入，將有助於公
司整體利潤率的提升，對公司今、明年展望維持正向。目前股價
交易於 2027 年 EPS 約 8~9 倍本益比，評價並未明顯偏高，給予
買進投資建議，目標價為 270 元(12x 2027 EPS) 。

貳、公 司 概 況

一. 公司簡介  
緯創資通 (Wistron) 成立於 2001 年 ， 前身為宏碁電腦的研製服務部
門，現為全球領先的資通訊產業專業代工大廠 (ODM) ，為全球頂
尖品牌提供從設計、製造到售後服務的全方位解決方案。公司核
心產品線涵蓋筆記型電腦、桌上型電腦、伺服器、儲存設備、工
業電腦、網路通訊設備及行動裝置等。近年在人工智慧運算需求
激增的背景下，緯創已成功轉化為 AI 伺服器基板與模組供應鏈中
的關鍵推手，成為全球 AI 硬體基礎架構的核心供應商。在產能佈
局上，緯創於台灣新竹、林口及高雄設有研發中心與高階生產線；
中國大陸則以昆山、成都為製造重心。為強化供應鏈韌性，公司
近年大幅擴張越南及馬來西亞產能，並於墨西哥與捷克設有規模
龐大的工廠，以就近服務北美及歐洲市場。主要客戶方面， AI 運
算與伺服器領域包含 NVIDIA 、 AMD 、 Intel 及各大雲端服務商
(Microsoft 、 Meta 、 Google 、 Amazon) ； PC 與消費電子則涵蓋
Dell 、HP、Lenovo 及 Acer 。主要競爭對手包括鴻海 (Foxconn) 、
廣達 (Quanta) 、仁寶 (Compal) 、英業達 (Inventec) 及和碩
(Pegatron) 。

1. 四大 CSP 上修今年資本支出達 7,450 億美元  
在生成式 AI 商機快速擴張帶動下，全球雲端基礎設施投資進入新
一輪高峰。亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和微軟認為其在先前的鉅額投資已
帶動營收明顯成長 ， 同時預估未來AI 潛在商機仍持續擴大 。 其中 ，
亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和 Meta 已陸續上調 2026 全年投資金額，且四
大雲端服務供應商 (CSP) 總資本支出將上升至 7,450 億美元新高
規模。亞馬遜、微軟、 Alphabet 與 Meta 2026 年第 1、2 季分別
為 1,306 億、1,701 億美元，同時亞馬遜、 Alphabet 和 Meta 再上
修 2026 全年資本支出金額， 2026 年資本支出預估將達 7,450 億
美元。而根據 TrendForce 最新產業研究，全球主要雲端服務供應
商(CSP) 為加速建置 AI 基礎設施，資本支出預估於 2026 年將年
增 98%，2027 年再成長 50% 至 1.3 兆美元左右 ， 年增率收斂的主
要原因，除了反映高基期因素之外，部分可歸咎為鉅額資本支出
對四大 CSP 財務衝擊日益擴大。然而，在 AI Inference 、Agentic 
AI、自研 ASIC 和新一代 AI 模型持續推升算力需求的情況下，預
期整體 CSP 投資金額將續創新高紀錄，產業成長有望從原先以
GPU 擴張為主，轉為包含 AI server 、液冷散熱、先進封裝、高速
互聯、電源和記憶體等基礎設施全面升級的態勢。

圖二、 2024-2027 年全球九大 CSP 資本支出總額預估 (單位 :十億美元 )

資料來源： TrendForce 、宏遠投顧整理

2. 2026 年全球 AI 伺服器出貨量預計年增 31% 
根據 TrendForce 最新 AI server 產業研究，近期超大型 CSP 、
Tier-2 資料中心業者對 NVIDIA GB/VR 等整櫃式 AI server 方案的
採購意願明顯提高，且 Google 、AWS 新一代 ASIC 平台於 2026
下半年陸續放量，加上中系業者擴大採用本地 AI 方案以滿足雲端
大型語言模型 (LLM) AI 需求，促使 TrendForce 上調 2026 年 AI

雙鴻 (3324 TT) 
水冷營收貢獻比重放大

永豐觀點 
水冷散熱營收貢獻大，持續關注獲利率表現。 
 投資評價與建議 
研究部維持中立建議：2H26 受惠 GB300 系列水冷散熱相關產品出貨增加，以及
AWS Trainium3及輝達 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產品開始出貨，逐漸增添貢獻。
Trainium3 4Q26 主要為小量產階段，預期主要貢獻放量將落在 2027 年。雙鴻目
前正在驗證輝達 Vera Rubin 世代水冷板，預計最快 9 月底通過驗證，待驗證完成
後進一步加入營收獲利貢獻預估。 
隨著 AI 伺服器散熱需求越來越高，不論 GPU、ASIC 散熱設計都越趨複雜，也加
大投資需求，對獲利率表現形成挑戰。水冷散熱供應者眾，目前水冷散熱零組件市
場以奇鋐及 Cooler Master 產能較大及佔據主要份額。雙鴻營運主要能受惠整體
水冷散熱滲透率、市場產值提升，帶動營收規模擴大及獲利金額成長。 預估雙鴻
2026 年、2027 年水冷散熱營收比重 59%、68%，稅後 EPS 56.93 元、79.87 元。
研究部維持中立建議。

### Page 2

2

雙鴻為台灣散熱模組廠商，主要提供風扇、散熱片、熱導管等設計組合而成散熱工
具，裝置在筆記型電腦、桌上型電腦、伺服器及智慧型手機等產品。高速運算晶片
發熱量持續增加， 散熱管理重要性提升。 散熱管理技術過往以主被動混合式熱管理
方案(鰭片+風扇)為主 ， 近年主流設計為均熱板 、 熱導管及3DVC 的散熱解決方案 ，
伺服器應用客戶積極導入水冷式散熱解決方案，六大關鍵零組件包含 Cold Plate、
CDU(Cooling Distribution Units)、Rack、RDHx、Quick Connectors、Manifold。 
雙鴻生產基地位於泰國、中國廣州、昆山、重慶、合肥。台灣散熱模組廠主要競爭
對手為奇鋐、Cooler Master、台達電、超眾及力致等等。客戶包括國內外筆電品
牌大廠及台灣 ODM 代工廠。2Q26 產品組合：PC 17%，VGA 4%，Server 78%，
Others 1%。 
水冷營收比重持續提高：先前雙鴻公告 7 月自結獲利，單月營收 37.7 億元，稅前
淨利 8.3 億元，稅後淨利 6.0 億元，稅後 EPS 6.47 元，優於預期，主因 7 月認列
部份 6 月遞延營收。8 月份客戶拉貨波動，單月營收月減 16.6%，預期 9 月份將
會回升。3Q26 雙鴻 GB300 水冷板、Manifold 出貨增加，以及預期 9 月份 AWS 
Trainium3 及輝達 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產品開始出貨，逐漸增加貢獻，主要
貢獻將落在 4Q26。 
研究部推估雙鴻 3Q26、4Q26 水冷營收比重達 61％、63%。營收分別為 103 億、
109 億元。水冷營收比重增加，同時增強獲利率表現，預估毛利率分別為29.9%、
30.3%，稅後 EPS 16.77 元、17.14 元。 
認證輝達 Vera Rubin 水冷板中 ：雙鴻目前正在驗證輝達 Vera Rubin 世代水冷板 ，
預計最快 9 月底通過驗證。研究部認為短期雙鴻出貨 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產
品將先以 Manifold 為主，待驗證完成後進一步加入營收獲利貢獻預估。同時雙鴻
也有望延續進入 Vera Rubin Ultra 專案，待後續相關水冷產品開發。 
ASIC 方面，雙鴻將量產 AWS Trainium3 水冷相關產品包含水冷板、 Inner 
Manifold、Rack Manifold，惟 4Q26 主要為小量產階段，預期主要貢獻放量將落
在 2027 年。後續包含 Meta ASIC 及 CDU 產品都有望額外增添貢獻雙鴻水冷營
收。 
產能持續擴充 ， 主要受惠水冷市場產值擴大 ：公司積極拓展伺服器水冷散熱市場機
會，2026 年、2027 年持續增加伺服器水冷產品產能。目前水冷板月產能包含廣州
及泰國共 400k pcs， 後續視情況在泰國增加100k~200k pcs。Manifold 台灣 2k、
泰國 3k。隨著 AI 伺服器散熱需求越來越高，不論 GPU、ASIC 散熱設計都越趨複
雜，如無塵室等級要求提高，也加大投資需求，對獲利率表現都會形成挑戰。 
水冷散熱供應者眾，目前水冷散熱零組件市場以奇鋐及 Cooler Master 產能較大
及佔據主要份額。雙鴻營運主要能受惠整體水冷散熱滲透率、市場產值提升，帶動
營收規模擴大及獲利金額成長。預估雙鴻 2026 年、2027 年水冷散熱營收比重
59%、68%。2026 年營收 385 億元，年增 65%，毛利率 29.6%，營益率 17.8%，
稅後 EPS 56.93 元。2027 年營收 513 億元，年增33%，毛利率 18.6%，稅後 EPS 
79.87 元。

設備訂單供不應求，訂單能見度長達 9~12 月 
展望 3Q26 隨 AI/先進製程/封裝/記憶體投資帶動設備需求強勁，整體營收估
計 YoY>QoQ，其中製造服務 YoY、QoQ 皆為成長，維修受先進製程高稼動
率支撐，惟富蘭登受到上季認列航太專案高基期影響，預估 QoQ 下滑、
YoY 仍呈成長。自主開發受到升級改版產品導入先進製程，預估  QoQ、
YoY 皆為成長。因此，預估 3Q26 營收季增 5%、毛利率受到春武里廠稼動
率提升、檢測業務因客戶部份帶料而預期有所改善，費用率持平、推估 EPS 
6.32 元。目前訂單能見度至 9~12 個月，部份品項可看到 27 年底，預期營
收逐季往上，2026~27 年營收維持新高格局。 
看好檢測代工量能，毛利率亦有機會逐步改善 
2Q26 營收結構為半導體設備代工 85%、維修服務 14%、自主開發設備 1%，
其中來自設備代工分別季增 11%/年增 14%，隨先進製程推進及晶片結構複
雜度提升，帶動蝕刻、薄膜沉積與檢測等關鍵設備需求，以上三者營收佔比
>5 成。Repair 季增 37%/年增 125%，除了晶圓廠 UTR 維持高檔，主要成
長來自富蘭登 6 月認列航太專案。檢測設備營收年增 6 倍/佔比提升至 14%。
持續看好檢測代工動能，基於先進製程複雜度提升帶動高精度量測與檢測需
求增加，預估 2026~27 年檢測業務數量機會倍增，毛利率可望在 2H26 交易
模式改客戶自備高價料件，雖然造成營收貢獻減少，但有助毛利率提升。 
AI 帶動先進製程/HBM 需求強勁，新增泰國二期擴產計劃 
根據 SEMI 預估 2026 年 WFE 市場規模年增 23%，主要由 AI 帶動先進製程
需求，並已獲得客戶更長訂單需求，預計產能將為目前泰國廠一倍，預計
2H27 陸續投產。展望 2026~27 年動能來自 AI/HBM/先進製程設備需求維持
高檔，檢測設備代工、富蘭登營收貢獻擴大等。本中心預估 2026/27 年
EPS 21.83/27.44 元，分別下修 5%/上修 5%，主要基於訂單需求強勁及新
增二期擴產，主要受新廠費用、檢測毛利率波動而調整假設基礎。 
元大觀點 
⧫  
預估 3Q26 營收呈季增/年增，營收逐季新高。隨先進製程/封裝、HBM
等加速投資 WFE，訂單能見度至 27 年底。 
⧫  
展望 2026/27 年主力客戶展望佳/公司供應比提升及檢測、富蘭登訂單
需求強勁，搭配泰國擴產，營運可望優於產業平均。 
⧫  
預估 2026/27 年 EPS 21.83/27.44 元，維持買進，惟目標本益比降至
13 倍。儘管營收動能強勁及中長期展望不看淡，然短期毛利率弱勢壓
抑獲利成長空間，亦使評價有所調整。

看好檢測代工量能，毛利率亦有機會逐步改善
2Q26 營收結構為半導體設備代工 85%、維修服務 14%、自主開發設備 1%，其中來自設備代工分
別季增 11%/年增 14%，隨先進製程推進及晶片結構複雜度提升，帶動蝕刻、薄膜沉積與檢測等關
鍵設備需求，以上三者營收佔比>5 成。Repair 季增 37%/年增 125%，除了晶圓廠 UTR 維持高檔，
主要成長來自富蘭登 6 月認列航太專案。檢測設備營收年增 6 倍/佔比提升至 14%。持續看好檢測
代工動能，基於先進製程複雜度提升帶動高精度量測與檢測需求增加，預估 2026~27 年檢測業務
數量機會倍增，毛利率可望在 2H26 交易模式改客戶自備高價料件，雖然造成營收貢獻減少，但有
助毛利率提升。
AI 帶動先進製程/HBM 需求強勁，新增泰國二期擴產計劃
根據 SEMI 預估 2026 年 WFE 市場規模年增 24%，主要由 AI 投資帶動先進製程/封裝/HBM 需求。

AMAT 最近法說釋出展望樂觀，並且已獲得客戶更長能見度訂單需求，因而 啟動新一輪擴產計劃。
公司董事會亦通過泰國廠二期資本支出，預計產能規模將為目前泰國廠一倍，預計 2H27 陸續投產。
展望 2026~27 年主要動能來自 AI/HBM/先進製程設備需求維持高檔，檢測設備代工、富蘭登營收
貢獻擴大等。本中心預估 2026/27 年 EPS 21.83/27.44 元，分別下修 5%/上修 5%，主要基於訂單
需求強勁及新增二期擴產，但下修毛利率假設基礎，主要受新廠費用、檢測毛利率波動而調整假設
基礎。

### Page 4

請參閱末頁之免責宣言。 台灣：半導體設備與耗材 2026 年 9 月 11 日 Foxsemicon 第4 頁，共 13頁  
產業概況  
先進製程與供應鏈在地化為大勢所趨 
自疫情後各國積極推動半導體供應鏈在地化，美國、歐洲、日本相繼祭出補貼以吸引先進製程及先
進封裝投資，使全球新廠與擴產計畫明顯增加，帶動設備與廠務族群自  2023 年起營收與市值持續
成長。 展望 2026 年，本中心預期設備與廠務族群仍將延續成長趨勢，主因包含 1)  AI 、HPC 需求
持續快速成長、先進製程產能加速放量 ; 2) 主要半導體製造商資本支出擴增、台積電美國建廠將於
2026 年加速，WFE (Wafer Fab Equipment) 將成長 9%。預估 2026 年主要晶圓廠資本支出達
1,792 億美元(YoY+37%)，其中台積電及海力士之資本支出年增分別為 51%/19%，美光同時也年
增 50%，反映 AI 帶動先進製程/HBM 相關設備需求強勁，將進一步推動廠務與設備需求加速成長。

2026~2027 年半導體設備支出持續創新高 
根據 SEMI 預估 2026/2027 年 WFE 成長 9/7%，其中 Memory 主要受到記憶體廠稼動率回升及 AI
帶動 HBM 需求強勁，Logic 除了 AI 相關投資以外，多數仍在消耗先前過剩產能為主，展望 2026
年景氣全面復甦、AI 持續擴大、新建廠效應，WFE 將進一步成長 9%，反映 AI 帶動先進製程/HBM
相關設備需求強勁，成熟製程方面，台積電也於 2026/7/16 表示海外成熟製程中以 PMIC 與 CMOS
需求較強，顯示未來成熟製程也仍有溫和成長的趨勢。

2026 年半導體設備銷售延續復甦力道 隨著晶圓代工成長 
2026 年全球半導體設備總銷售額成長 16.2%達 1,450 億美元，預估 2027 年成長 7.6%，連續三年
創新高。預估晶圓廠設備銷售將於 2026/2027 年分別年成長 17.1%/7.7%，主要成長來自 AI 帶動
先進製程、HBM 需求強勁。 
觀察過去歷史循環，半導體設備營收年增率與晶圓代工廠營收年增率連動性高，且落後晶圓代工廠
約 2~3 季回升，並且半導體設備股價表現則與營收年增率呈現高度連動。

### Page 6

請參閱末頁之免責宣言。 台灣：半導體設備與耗材 2026 年 9 月 11 日 Foxsemicon 第6 頁，共 13頁  
獲利調整與股票評價  
維持買進評等、目標價降至 350 元 
元大最新預估京鼎 2026/27 年 EPS 分別為 21.83 /27.44 元，分別下修 5%/上修 5%，儘管公司來
自 AI 與 HPC 持續擴張，帶動先進邏輯、記憶體與先進封裝投資，設備訂單需求維持強勁，且動能
將延續至 2027 年。惟毛利率受到產品組合、泰國新廠初期營運成本影響，較預期低 0.5~1 個百分
點。目前訂單能見度長達 9~12 個月，部份訂單甚至到 27 年底。預估 3Q26 營收 QoQ、YoY 皆為
正成長，後續營收逐季攀升，2026 年營運表現可望優於 WFE 產業平均水準。2026 年營收主要假
設，雖然產業成長約 19~25% ，但部份設備拉貨 已提前至 2025 年 反應 ( 公司 25 年營收
YoY+26%>WFE YoY+ 12%)，26 年主要動能來自檢測新代工訂單、富蘭登完整年度營收貢獻，加
上泰國春武里 3Q26 投產，估計營收成長 21%，優於產業平均成長，毛利率估計較 25 年下滑 2 個
百分點，主要檢測設備業務為整機代工，毛利率偏低，另外，春武 里廠折舊估計加 1.6 億元及其他
初期營運成本等。27 年營收 YoY 成長由 7%提升至 15%，主要 2H27 新增泰國二期部份產能貢獻，
毛利率預期在檢測交易模式改變，估計較 26 年有所改善。根據 2026/27 年預估獲利換算本益比為
13/10 倍，落於歷史區間 7-15 倍的中下緣，略低於國內同業平均本益比約 18-22 倍、低於國外同業
30-45 倍。看好 2026~27 年營運持續創新高、中長期來自先進製程邏輯相關設備需求強勁及各國政
策建立自主供應鏈為重要動能。維持買進評等，惟短期股價反映毛利率低於預期而使評價面受影響，
因而目標本益比由 15 倍降至 13 倍， 2027 年 EPS 27.44 元，推得目標價 350 元。

公司簡介  
京鼎成立於 2001 年，專注於半導體、自動化及微污染防治設備之製造及銷售，前段晶圓製造以生產製程及檢測設備為主，
包含有化學機械研磨 (CMP)、薄膜沉積(PVD/CVD/ALD)、蝕刻(Etching)等設備製造，而備件則以真空製程元件及其他精密
機構件為主，包含濺鍍瞄準器、氣體整流器、CMP 研磨頭等。京鼎於 2002 年通過 AMAT 半導體設備製造商之合格供應商
認證，目前 AMAT 佔占公司營收約 8 成，其中京鼎在 CVD/Etch 代工營收佔比超過 5 成。

ESG 分析  
分別藉由「在 ESG 議題上的曝險」和「個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力」兩個面向來衡量公司於 ESG 上的表現。 
► ESG 總分： 京鼎整體的 ESG 風險評級屬於低風險，於 Sustainalytics 資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排名亦排行於靠前的位置，
但在設備代工行業中的公司中排名優於同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 京鼎的整體曝險屬於低等水準，約等同於半導體設備行業的平均水準。公司較需要改善的 ESG 
議題包含人力資本、商業道德及資源使用等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：京鼎在針對重大 ESG 議題的管理水準和執行力屬中等。京鼎於 ESG 相關揭露程度
高，顯示其對投資人及大眾的責任感極佳，雖說公司有針對重大 ESG 議題進行管控，但對於關鍵領域仍缺乏相關政策
及計畫。然而，目前京鼎尚未涉及任何 ESG 重大爭議。
